purpose: one-case fresh end-to-end nonempty-tree integration check; not a benchmark experiment

cases.question: Choose two real continuous decision variables x and y, each between 0.5 and 2 inclusive. Minimize exp(x^2) + exp(y^2), subject to x*y >= 1. Here exp is the natural exponential function and ^ denotes exponentiation. Return the optimized objective value as a single scalar.
